title: ThinkLatent site — v7: the 42 feature decisions on the v3 site

n_main.text: Home · v7 (features 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 20, 24, 25, 29, 38, 40). Sections: hero with the mandate line and two buttons + four editor-rotated tiles (Hero web part, Layers; the rotation is a monthly edit) · the compounding strip, six sourced numbers with a since-launch trend (Text, Heading 2 + Normal; the sparkline is an Image until Power BI) · named products, three cards (Quick Links Grid) · four audience doors + the Work with ThinkLatent ladder (Quick Links Grid + Text) · proof: the latest win with number and partner quote, this quarter's awards, the new-partner post, the Head of ThinkLatent's reflection (Text + News) · latest from the team with category buttons (News) · the TL;DR from the monthly email + Coming up (Text + Events) · ThinkLatent community (Viva Engage web part) + Use AI at the Enterprise links (Quick Links Compact) · the questions teams ask first (collapsible sections) · Talk to us (Call to action). Comments off on Home only.

n_mandate.text: Mandate · v7 (features 3, 10), in Jithin's words. Why our own models (vendor AI makes everyone as good as the vendor; the customer feedback loop is ours) · Compounding, three points (expert-in-the-loop, if it does not compound nothing goes further, AUM is not the moat) · Scale: ten tasks to a hundred by the same people · Four things measured (latency, cost, scale, competitive advantage) · How it is delivered: the four named products · the Head of ThinkLatent quote + the proof links. Text web parts throughout, Quick Links for the products; evergreen page with two owners and a review date.

n_products.text: Products · v7 (features 2, 9, 18, 19, 40). Hero with in-page nav · TLM lineage as a static Image (five generations, TLM4 branching into Core, Distil, Domain; the interactive one lives in the portal) · three short outcome cards, one per tier, each linking the full card in the ThinkLatent Portal (Quick Links or Text cards) · generations in outcomes · ThinkLatent Portal section with the platform pieces · TL Index summary tile with as-of date and the three-line explainer (Text; numbers from the TL Index only) · Use AI at the Enterprise links · Releases (News, Category = Release). Owners: site editor + Head of AI Products.

n_trust.text: ThinkLatent Trust · v7 (features 17, 17b, 42): a named program as its own section under Products. Jump links · the five-step lifecycle (intake, risk review, TL Index evaluation, human review, monitoring) with who signs and what you see (Text cards) · what we show and what we don't · status by product (List web part, column formatting: glyph + word) · policy and who owns it, three links to the governance owner and Risk · ask a governance question (Forms). Owners: Head of AI Products + Risk liaison; reviewed quarterly.

n_team.text: Team · v7 (features 5, 22, 29, 35, 42). Three function cards with a mission line, the head and a quarterly output count (Text) · profiles heads-first, each auto-listing the person's posts and publications (Highlighted content by author); everyone else in the People web part with role labels and start years · three locations · how we work (unchanged) · six awards + recognition (winners featured on Home, Viva Engage shout-out) · 'Work in ThinkLatent' slot marked after launch.

n_wins.text: Wins · v7 (features 8, 25, 39). Featured win: story + before/after number with source and date + partner quote + 'what compounded' · wins as a List (filters: year, business unit, product; gallery or list) · new partners: a post per engagement (News, Category = Partner) · what partner teams say (one quote rotates on Home) · Bring us a problem (Forms with a named owner; hands off to ThinkLatent Portal intake later).

n_research.text: Research · v7 (feature 10, Capital One layout). Three themes · the university lab in order: intro and link to the lab site, four project cards, the Head of ThinkLatent quote, joint outputs (Publications filtered the university), MScAC interns, events, directors, partner stories, lab tours marked later · methods in use. The teal section is the immersive moment.

n_pubs.text: Publications · v7 (feature 16). List web part filtered by type, year, theme, the university and status (internal memo, external, patent, talk, filed, in production), authors linked to profiles · conference roundups, one post per conference (News, Category = Roundup) · in the news (links only; Comms approval kept per row).

n_blog.text: Blog · v7 (features 11, 12, 15, 33, 39). Filters as button links incl. Perspective, Deep dive, conference roundups, year in review · featured post · cards carry the Perspective or Deep dive chip · 'ThinkLatent in 2026' year-in-review block (every January) · leadership series · how the blog runs (BAIR model: researchers write, 2–3 editors + a function-head advisor, at most one post every two weeks, syndication to the intranet and the office news, the external blog via Comms later) · newsletter archive (the newsletter stays an email). Comments on, moderated.

n_persp.text: AI Perspectives · v7 (features 13, 14, 20, 26). Teal hero · next session with abstract, host bio and guest · schedule as text (table) with the demo edition marked after launch · recordings library (Stream; also onboarding) · ask for it on the roadmap (Forms) + Viva Engage feed · two after-launch panels: the quarterly demo edition (8–12 minute talks, live demo each, one Q&A, recorded, recap) and the podcast pilot.

n_viday.text: ThinkLatent Day · v7 (features 36, 37): yearly, alongside the Enterprise's AI Summit. Hero with date, days, teams · how it runs (before, day 1, day 2, after) · this year's three themes + judging questions · sign up a team (Forms; business teams first, ThinkLatent builders matched) · ThinkLatent at the AI Summit sessions · past winners (winners join the quarter's awards; the best idea enters the Idea Lab as a Seed).

n_gloss.text: Glossary · v7 (feature 23): 44 terms, one line each, as a List web part filtered by letter; owned by the editorial board; Perspective posts link here instead of explaining.

n_glance.text: ThinkLatent at a glance · v7 (feature 30): one plain page (headings and lists, every number with a source) so Copilot, search and a new colleague can answer 'what has ThinkLatent done on X?'; kept current each quarter by the site editor. Text web parts only.

n_write.text: Write for ThinkLatent · v7 (features 11, 12, 31, 32, 42). Jump links · eleven templates (+ Win story, Model card, Conference roundup, New partner) as Quick Links Grid · Perspective vs Deep dive · three steps (review within five working days) · how the blog runs · the ThinkLatent voice · submit (Forms). Owners: site editor + editorial advisor.

n_tpl.text: Templates · v7 (features 31, 32, 33). All eleven carry the new chrome, comments (on everywhere, moderated) and the footer. Release notes gained Getting started (three links: access, the Relay call, the portal card and playground), Acknowledgments and Contact; links go to the portal card and the index run, never weights or code. New: Win story (story, before/after number, partner quote, what compounded), Model card (what for, who uses it, limits plainly, the index, access; full card in the portal), Conference roundup (who went, three things we bring back, who to ask), New partner (problem in their words, what starts, first milestone, contact). Save each as a SharePoint page template; the Category property drives the News filters.

nav.text: Navigation · v7 (feature 21): Mandate · Products ▾ (TLM, ThinkLatent Portal, the TL Index, ThinkLatent Trust) · Our work ▾ (Wins, Research, Publications) · Stories ▾ (Blog, AI Perspectives, ThinkLatent Day) · Team, plus the red Write for ThinkLatent button; Home is the logo. SharePoint: hub mega menu, two levels. Active item sage with green 900 text (custom.css). Footer: Follow, Viva Engage, site map incl. Glossary and ThinkLatent at a glance, products, elsewhere, contact the editors.

fid.text: Fidelity (v7, 2026-11-05): the v3 structure and the kit's colour system v1.1 (primary green, secondary teal, Decision Red on buttons and the stripe), no imagery (flat plate tints hold every image slot until the team's image set exists), and the 42 feature decisions from the scout inventory built in. Generated from gen/site6.py + pages_a–e.py (pages) and gen/tpl6.py (templates). SharePoint: T1 = theme, sections, Text, Quick Links, News, Events, People, Lists with column formatting, Highlighted content, Call to action, Page properties, Embed, Forms, Viva Engage; T2 = custom.css for the red buttons and stripe, pills, radii, glass, numerals. Two owners and a review date on Mandate, Products, ThinkLatent Trust, Write for ThinkLatent, Glossary and ThinkLatent at a glance. Comments on everywhere except Home.

src.text: Content sources: the register and capability catalogue (TLM1–5, Core/Distil/Domain, Relay, HyperPod, self-healing, AI Index, Gateway, ThinkLatent Portal), Jithin's mandate in his words (decision 10), the public the university lab site (projects, faculty, directors, events, press) and the scout brief (claude/scout-brief-team-site.md). Names in brackets are placeholders; numbers marked with a source are from those sources, the rest are layout values until rundown part 3.
